name: The Charlie WeHo Luxurious 2BDR/2BATH Apartment
description: Upper level, luxurious, two-story two-bedroom two bath suite. The open living room and dining floor plan portray beauty and character with natural material and earthy colors, perfect for families. The built in office spaces, plush armchairs and large walk in closets make you feel right at home. Each unit has it's private rooftop patio which overlook the hotels grounds.
neighborhood_overview:
The ultimate luxury in Los Angeles is that of sanctuary, a place removed from the cacophonous commotion of the city, while still posted in the city’s bustling epicenter.

The Charlie is located on Sweetzer Ave, right between Melrose and Santa Monica Blvd. Right around the corner from a buffet of restaurants, shops and more.
host_about: Hidden behind a wooden gate on a quiet residential street in West Hollywood, a compound of English Tudor-style bungalows has become a fairy-tale-like home away from home for those lucky enough to discover its charms. Sprinkled with the pixie dust of Hollywood history, the property at 819 North Sweetzer was once owned by film legend Charlies Spencer Chaplin, infamous for his sexual exploits, and famous for his artistic proliferation. Chaplin built this cluster of cottages after purchasing the land – once a farm owned by actress Ruth Gordon’s family – in 1924. Converted into the exclusive Charlie Hotel in 2008, it has played host to a constellation of starlets both in Chaplin's time and now. It remains, after all these years, a place of refuge for the beautiful and creative.
